note: Patterns only. Personal-data entries are salted SHA-256 hashes of normalized tokens; this file must never contain the data it guards against. Escape path separators in host-path regexes so the config does not match itself. Identity tokens (persona names, brands) use the personalData salt and normalization. Private-network rules match RFC 1918 (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16), CGNAT/Tailscale IPv4 (100.64/10) and the Tailscale IPv6 ULA /48; write examples and tests with the documentation ranges (192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24, 2001:db8::/32), which never match, and assemble any private-range test fixture from fragments at runtime.

personalData.normalization: split camelCase, lowercase, split on non-alphanumerics; unigrams and adjacent bigrams (joined by one space) are hashed

identityData.note: HMAC-SHA256(key = secret salt, message = normalized token), same normalization as personalData. The salt is never committed: CI reads the LEAK_GATE_SALT repository secret, local runs read ~/.config/hermes-zouroboros/leak-gate-salt (mode 0600). Without it these rules skip with a notice.
